channel.name: Cooking Channel US
channel.title: Bizarre Foods: Delicious Destinations
channel.desc: Andrew Zimmern's culinary curiosity knows no bounds. Extending his popular "Bizarre Foods" franchise, the James Beard Award-winning chef continues his quest to find the most interesting dishes around the world. From melt-in-your-mouth chocolate in Zurich to decadent gelato in Florence, savory paella in Barcelona to creamy clam chowder in Boston, Zimmern samples quintessential, "to die for" delicacies that define iconic cities. Each half-hour episode focuses on one destination's classic foods -- where they came from, how they are prepared, and the right way to eat them.

channel.name: Cooking Channel US
channel.title: The Zimmern List
channel.desc: During a lifelong quest to experience the most unique, traditional fare in cities around the world, chef/TV personality Andrew Zimmern has traveled nearly everywhere while eating almost anything along the way. From iconic restaurants to off-the-beaten-path markets and shops, Zimmern reveals his best-of itinerary -- his personal picks for dishes and food experiences so delicious that they're unforgettable. Each half-hour episode finds the host visiting a different city, serving as the viewers' guide while he recounts personal food memories, shares the culinary history of each location, and shows what to eat and where to find it.

channel.title: Cheap Eats
channel.desc: Traveling can be expensive, with airfare and hotel accommodations often costing hundreds of dollars each, so when you're on a vacation, you likely want to try to cut expenses in some areas. Food blogger Ali Khan can help you save on food costs in various American cities. In each episode of "Cheap Eats," he spends 12 hours in a given locale and has a $35 food budget. With that cash, he must maximize his investment for breakfast, lunch, a snack and dinner -- getting the biggest and tastiest delicacies he can find while staying under his limit. As he explores affordable options in each city, Khan meets with local chefs to find out about the area's culinary scene.
